_readme: Conference PSA: 1,000 shared LHS draws, conditional on each selected point-calibrated backbone. Placeholder HTA distributions are excluded. Calibration-fit uncertainty is handled as a separate plausible-fit/structural analysis, not mislabelled as posterior uncertainty.

tiers_to_sample.notes: Estimated/calibrated marginals are not independently sampled because the confirmed shortlist is not a posterior and the calibrated coordinates are correlated.

correlation_groups.notes: Not implemented. Independence is a declared limitation of this conditional PSA.

exclude_placeholders.notes: Unsourced placeholder distributions are excluded from the conference PSA.
